name: bridge-rich-text
description: Stream Deck plugin: insert coloured bridge suit symbols as rich text

scripts.pack: npm run build && streamdeck pack com.monxas.bridgesuits.sdPlugin --output dist --force
scripts.release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:helper && (if [ "$(uname)" = Darwin ]; then npm run build:helper:macos; fi) && npm run pack
scripts.test:windows:prepare: bash scripts/build-helper.sh && mkdir -p dist/windows-test && x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc -O2 -Wall -static -o dist/windows-test/harness.exe test/windows/harness.c -luser32 && cp com.monxas.bridgesuits.sdPlugin/native/bridge-paste-helper.exe test/windows/run-wine.sh dist/windows-test/ && tsx test/windows/make-requests.ts dist/windows-test
